nodes.label: SAM2ImagePredictor

nodes.label: SAM2VideoPredictor
nodes.desc: Video predictor managing inference_state: init_state, add_new_points_or_box, propagate_in_video

nodes.label: SAM2AutomaticMaskGenerator
nodes.desc: Grid-prompted whole-image mask generation with small-region post-processing

nodes.label: build_sam2
nodes.desc: Hydra compose of model configs plus checkpoint loading into a ready module

nodes.label: build_sam2_video_predictor
nodes.desc: Same factory, returning a SAM2VideoPredictor configured for streaming video

nodes.label: _load_checkpoint
nodes.desc: Loads local or downloaded .pt weights into the instantiated model

nodes.label: SAM2Base
nodes.desc: Core module holding the streaming memory loop and SAM head orchestration

nodes.desc: One frame of tracking: condition memory, decode masks, encode new memory

nodes.desc: Selects condition frames and cross-attends the memory bank into current features

nodes.desc: Runs prompt encoder and mask decoder, returning masks, IoU scores, and object pointers

nodes.label: select_closest_cond_frames
nodes.desc: Picks the closest conditioning frames so the memory budget stays bounded

nodes.desc: Mask head with dynamic multimask selection based on stability scores

nodes.desc: Two-way attention over tokens then upsampling to the final mask logits

nodes.desc: Embeds points and boxes sparsely, masks densely, with a positional grid

nodes.desc: Turns click coordinates and labels into sparse embeddings

nodes.label: TwoWayTransformer
nodes.desc: Attention blocks letting image tokens and prompt tokens inform each other

nodes.desc: Attention with rotary position embeddings used in the decoder's cross-attention

nodes.label: ImageEncoder
nodes.desc: Hiera trunk plus FPN neck producing multi-scale feature maps

nodes.label: FpnNeck
nodes.desc: Feature pyramid neck returning hierarchical feature positions

nodes.label: Hiera
nodes.desc: Hierarchical ViT with windowed multi-scale attention staged across resolutions

nodes.label: MultiScaleBlock
nodes.desc: Norm, pooled multi-scale attention, MLP, with optional window partitioning

nodes.label: PatchEmbed
nodes.desc: Convolutional patch embedding that feeds pixels into the Hiera trunk

nodes.label: MemoryEncoder
nodes.desc: Produces maskmem features: downsampled masks fused with frame features

nodes.label: MaskDownSampler
nodes.desc: Strided conv stack shrinking predicted masks to memory resolution

nodes.label: Fuser
nodes.desc: Stacks CX blocks that fuse mask evidence with backbone features

nodes.label: MemoryAttention
nodes.desc: Self-then-cross attention conditioning current features on stored memory

nodes.label: MemoryAttentionLayer
nodes.desc: Single layer: self-attention, cross-attention to memory, RoPE-aware

nodes.desc: Loads and resizes frames from images or video files into a tensor

nodes.label: AsyncVideoFrameLoader
nodes.desc: Background thread prefetching frames to hide decode latency

nodes.label: fill_holes_in_mask_scores
nodes.desc: Connected-component cleanup removing holes and disconnected islands
